text: A TM file is a few rules: state, symbol read, symbol written, move, next state. tm NAME compiles it to an 8080 program that steps a real tape.
The head starts at 0x5000, 4096 bytes into the banked window. Busy beavers wander left and right from there, one cell per rule.
Travel is the sum of head jumps. Run pal1.tm and pal2.tm on the same 32-character palindrome: one tape is quadratic, two tapes are linear.
pal2.tm is best with the tapes lever at 2. Its second TM tape then lives on machine tape 1 at the same window offset; select it here to see the copy.
On halt the program prints the final state (yes or no), the visited part of each tape with blanks trimmed, and steps=N.
